title: Add animation keyframes in Premiere
note: Select a clip containing an effect and open Effect Controls. Use Toggle Animation beside a property, move the playhead, and adjust its value to create a keyframe. Add another keyframe at a different time for movement or a changing effect.

title: Display keyframes in Premiere timeline
note: To edit effect keyframes directly in the timeline, use its Wrench menu to show video keyframes, then select the appropriate property on the clip. The Effect Controls panel can also show a property's value and velocity graph.

title: Automate audio track volume in Premiere
note: Expand an audio track in the timeline, switch Show Keyframes to Show Track Keyframes, and select a track property such as Volume. The Pen tool can modify the level line or add automation keyframes; distinguish track adjustments from a single audio clip's settings.
